## CASE FILES ("CONTRACTS")

### 01 Royal Daring HC — Communication & Sponsoring (featured)
Royal Daring Club de Molenbeek, Brussels field hockey club founded in 1922, 19 teams, ~620 members. Season 2025-26.
Problem: how can an amateur club professionalize its image and funding with limited human and financial resources?
Deliverables: complete brand guidelines (Daring Red #C8102E, Black, Gold #C9A84C, Off-white; Playfair Display + DM Sans),
bilingual FR/NL partner website (Netlify: leafy-pavlova-69305b.netlify.app), 9-page partner PDF brochure generated with
Python + ReportLab, sponsor packages (5 tiers + Youth Pack; LED board, jersey, field assets, match posters, social,
CSR/youth), social media adaptations (weekend recap carousel, matchday stories, playoff poster, merchandising,
bilingual camps, portrait template), physical bilingual signage, LinkedIn page creation, Notion editorial handover.
Stack: HTML5, CSS3, vanilla JavaScript, Python ReportLab, GitHub, Netlify, Claude Code, Codex.

### 02 ASN95 Signal — Head of Communications
Sponsor activation (+467% CTR), visual identity built week by week, season-long matchday photography
(Sony α6400 + SEL70350G). 26 league matches, 4 youth camps, 2 general assemblies, 30th anniversary covered.

### 03 BLAST Strategy — "David vs Goliath 2.0" (23 pages, PESTEL / VRIO / SWOT)
BLAST ($11M cash, FY24 revenue 82.1M +13%, net result -3.96M, gross margin 15.7%) vs EFG (Saudi PIF-backed, $1.5Bn valuation).
Valve 2025 regulation ends franchised partner leagues and the Louvre Agreement advantage.
Recommendation: India pivot via JV with Reliance (600M mobile gamers, 19% CAGR, $9.2Bn by 2029, 480M JioGames subscribers,
-80% cost structure). Roadmap: H1 2026 Mumbai hub + Jio/Paytm; H2 2026 D2C & Watch-to-Earn (ARPU +50%); 2027 break-even
(mix EU 60% / India 20% / MENA 20%). CSR "Brand Safety Shield" for CSRD-bound Western sponsors.
PDF: /assets/blast-case-study.pdf
